0022600001.text: Both the Detroit Pistons and Boston Celtics open their 2026-27 seasons when Detroit hosts Boston, and the Pistons have no players listed as unavailable. Boston has ten players listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions: Baylor Scheierman, Derrick White, Devin Carter (illness), Jayson Tatum, Mike Conley, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta, Paul George, Payton Pritchard, and Sam Hauser (the rest are for rest). The Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1 and took their most recent meeting 104-103 in Detroit on January 19, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Detroit a 50% chance to win.
